notes: «قالا حدثنا» makes Muhammad b. al-Sabbah and Ahmad b. Sinan one level of co-transmitters, and both routes meet at Sufyan.
The Companion is not named: «عن أبيه» is a relation (Buraydah's father-link is the Companion of the story).
The question and answer («جاء رجل ... فسأله») are in the matn, not chain links.
